subject: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

Hi team —

DataEase (Lisa copied) just flagged a multi-day spike in billable token cost that they cannot attribute to any single model or endpoint. They want an "interactive timeline" in Console where their CS/finance users can:

- Select date ranges and see per-route (endpoint) cumulative cost and median P90 latency
- Toggle grouping by model family (gptx/opt-like) vs route metadata (tenant_id, route_name)
- Have anomaly flags (automatic) when cost per route deviates >40% from baseline for >= 6 hours, with a short explanation (e.g., model change, sample rate change, burst)

Why this matters: DataEase is in contract renewal this quarter (DE-4729). If we cannot show them clear root cause + a Console tool to triage, renewal risks being delayed. They want something they can use without asking Support.

Attached: screenshot from the customer showing the spike, and a quick proto of the alert spec.

Ask: can Eng/Product scope a minimal delivery we could put behind a feature flag for the tenant in 6 weeks? If not, what is the smallest first step (e.g., exportable CSV + anomaly email) we can commit to?

Mina
Director, GTM 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: datasease_route-sample-snapshot.png, proto-cost-alert-spec.md

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

+1 on urgency — tagging infra/telemetry questions early. A couple quick items from infra side: 

1) What granularity of attribution do we need? Per-route daily/hourly? Per-request? Our cost model attribution currently maps tokens to a route_id + model_variant; we can roll up to hourly per-route cost fairly cheaply, but per-request is heavier (needs event enrich).

2) Sampling: to keep storage and query costs down, we should decide if an aggregated timeseries suffices (preferred) or if we need raw spans for root-cause. Aggregates + a link to a few raw samples when anomaly fires is a good middle ground.

3) Anomaly detection: we can prototype a simple statistical rule (baseline = last 14 days median; alert when current window > baseline * 1.4) and surface it in Console with a reason bucket (increased qps, changed model variant, gauge mismatch).

I can sketch infra requirements if Product signs off on scope.

—Logan
Senior SRE, Observability

Quote of previous:> DataEase (Lisa copied) just flagged a multi-day spike in billable token cost that they cannot attribute to any single model or endpoint.

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

Thanks, Mina + Logan. Prioritization thoughts from Product:

- We should aim for a Phase 1 that delivers: interactive hourly-timeseries per-route for last 30 days + export CSV + a basic anomaly flag with a link to a downloadable sample of requests contributing to the anomaly. That should be enough for renewals and reduces support burden.

- Phase 2: integrate with rollout/route metadata (labels, canary tags) and provide suggested remediation (e.g., reduce sample rate, force fallback model).

Questions for SRE/Eng:
- Can we rely on existing per-route aggregation (route_id + model_variant) or do we need to add a separate telemetry pipeline?
- SLA for the feature? If DataEase wants tenant-visible flags in Console, what latency (near-real-time vs hourly?)

If we can commit to Phase 1 in 6 weeks behind feature flag for DE-4729, Product will own UX copy and acceptance criteria. I'll open a JIRA with acceptance and mockups.

Camila
Product Manager, Console

Quoted earlier:> I can sketch infra requirements if Product signs off on scope.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 14:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

Quick technical note from infra:

- Aggregation: we already persist hourly token counts by route_id and model_variant into tsdb for billing purposes; we can repurpose that to compute hourly cost by applying the per-model unit price. Storage impact: minimal.

- Anomaly windows: implementing the 14-day median baseline and sliding 6-hour window is straightforward for a prototype. We should expose the rule configuration in Console so CS can adjust sensitivity.

- Root-cause pointers: to provide a small sample of raw requests we will need to keep a 0.1% sample of request metadata for 30 days (sampled events include route_id, model_variant, prompt_hash, token_count). I attached a short proto for the alert payload and the sample export format.

- Fallback: when telemetry lag occurs, we can show "insufficient telemetry" and fall back to billing aggregates (daily).

I'll volunteer to build an initial query and wire it behind a feature flag. ETA: prototype query + alerting job in ~3 weeks if we don't need schema changes.

Rishi
Principal Backend Engineer, Inference Runtime

Attachments: proto-cost-alert-spec.md, sample-telemetry-query.txt

> Camila: If we can commit to Phase 1 in 6 weeks behind feature flag for DE-4729, Product will own UX copy and acceptance criteria.

From: Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick alignment. A few clarifications from DataEase: 

- Hourly granularity is ideal; near-real-time not required, hourly updates are fine.
- The sample export is critical — we need the top 200 requests contributing to the spike (by token_count) so our engineers can debug prompt changes.
- Sensitivity: 40% over baseline is a good starting point; allow CS to tune per-tenant.

We're on a renewal call on Jan 8; having Phase 1 behind a flag would be a major positive signal. Happy to join a short scoping call this week.

—Lisa
Head of Platform Operations, DataEase

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa@datasease.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: interactive per-route cost timeline + anomaly alerting for enterprise tenant

Thanks all — action items from my side: 

1) Camila to open JIRA INFR-9281 with acceptance criteria + mockups (Camila, please tag Product QA).
2) Rishi to deliver prototype query + alert job in ~3 weeks (Rishi).
3) Logan to document sampling and data-lag tradeoffs; plan for a CSV export in Phase 1 (Logan).
4) Laura to draft customer-facing note and flag for renewal team (Laura).
5) Mina to coordinate a 30-minute scoping call with DataEase this week — will send calendar invite.

If we can get a feature-flagged Phase 1 before Jan 8, we will include it in the renewal briefing. Thanks everyone for the quick turn.

Mina
